Messages.Author: Tenrin
Messages.Body:
Necromancy Strike: put this card on the opposing minion. If this minion is a mortal, he or she is burned. During his or her untap phase, the minion with this card takes 1 unpreventable damage. The minion with this card may burn it as a +1 stealth action.
Necromancy As above, and this strike inflicts 1 damage as well.

It doesn't say a minion may only have/be affected by one during the untap phase (rather than stacking), so is there something I'm missing that would make that the case? Most other cards I'm finding have that clause.
